title: stellaris foliosa
intro: Stellaris foliosa, commonly known as Star Anise, is a flowering plant native to China and Southeast Asia. The health benefits of Stellaris foliosa include its use in traditional medicine to treat respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which help in reducing pain and inflammation. The bioactive constituents of Stellaris foliosa include essential oils, particularly anethole, which is responsible for its medicinal properties and distinct fragrance.
